items.title: 11/09 Buzzy Bee's Ocean Data Mission
items.description:
Help Ollie update her ocean sightings using Python.

* Create the starting list: ["Ray", "Eel", "Crab", "Turtle"].

* Use append() to add "Shark" to the end.

* Use insert() to place "Octopus" at index 1.

* Use pop() to remove the item currently at index 2.

* Print the list and its length after each change.

Silver Challenge: Translate your three operations into AP pseudocode.
Gold Challenge: Use .copy() to create a separate list and explain how copying differs from sharing.
